impact.resources: Same staging API and 10 existing collectors. Exclude only an observed non-navigation advertising endpoint. No service/scopes, schedules, budget, work limit, concurrency or identity changes.

impact.dependencies: Existing request boundary, shared source budget, fail-closed primary navigation and unchanged writers/resolver; no dependencies or migration.

recovery.procedure: Restore recorded prior exact collector snapshots and prior API on the same pinned staging services. Preserve all source pause/quarantine state and immutable history. No rollback database writes.
recovery.trigger: Wrong destination/identity, integrity risk, duplicate requests, required source denial or bounded rollout failure: contain the affected source and restore prior source snapshot.
recovery.backup: Retained exact prior Git and deployment snapshots; archive checksum recorded in preflight. No migration or irreversible mapping change.
